name: Paleoclimatology & Paleoceanography
summary: How past climates are reconstructed from natural archives and what they teach about climate sensitivity and change.

topics.name: Climate proxies and archives: principles and calibration
Ice cores: temperature, greenhouse gases and dust
Marine sediments: foraminiferal isotopes, alkenones and Mg/Ca
Terrestrial archives: speleothems, tree rings, lake sediments and pollen
Glacial-interglacial cycles and the Last Glacial Maximum
Abrupt events: Dansgaard-Oeschger, Heinrich events and the Younger Dryas
The Holocene and the last millennium
Deep-time climates: Cretaceous hothouse, PETM and Cenozoic cooling
